steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with one invited vendor bid, as required for prepared-state cases.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer configuration.
Apply the required bidding-time rejection configuration.
Allow buyer bid editing as required by the scenario configuration.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the scenario configuration.
Reach the RFQ Responses view where the stage Settings menu is available.
Open the Edit Evaluation Time dialog from the RFQ Settings menu.
Confirm the expected evaluation-time dialog opened.
Capture the dialog's evaluation end time before confirming with no selection.

args.goal: In the open Edit Evaluation Time dialog, leave every radio option unselected, including deselecting an already-selected option if necessary, then click Ok and stop after the dialog closes.

steps.note: Perform the case-specific no-selection interaction that has no dedicated catalog action.
Verify that Ok closes the evaluation-time dialog.
Verify that the evaluation end time remains unchanged after accepting Ok.
